text: Yes, that row's right. I told you: I'm always here. You've proved I keep long hours, 0x00.
style: SAFETYNET's cryptographic-hardware analyst. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Calm, precise, technically fluent; a colleague you trust. Tonight he is the mole, not yet unmasked, being interviewed by an agent he once taught: warm, unhurried, helpful to a fault. The only tell is that nothing rattles him -- in a building full of frightened people, he is serene.
